svg.title: PUM controls panel
svg.desc: A real OpenTUI render of PUM's controls panel, showing prompt, agent, session, command, and application shortcuts.

g.text: PUM workflow — prompt or steer · cache prompts · attach images · run managed worktree agents in parallel
switch transcripts · merge successful agents · persist sessions · use Settings and safety checks
